# Overview

Bump FlashMLA to vllm-project/FlashMLA@5dceadb (vllm-project/FlashMLA#30), which syncs upstream's 2026.09.30 release (deepseek-ai/FlashMLA#229). Upstream changed the DeepSeek-V4.1 KV cache records to an interleaved layout, so this moves vLLM's V4.1 cache writers and readers to it and aligns the packed DSv4.1 block to the new decode kernels.

## Claims

- vLLM builds against FlashMLA 5dceadb. V4.1 records (528 B MXFP8, 288 B NVFP4) written by vLLM now use the interleaved layout, and FlashMLA's V4.1 decode kernels and vLLM's own gathers read back exactly what the writers stored.
- DeepSeek-V4.1 serves end to end on SM100 with both FlashMLA backends; GSM8K is in the table below.
- KV capacity: a packed DSv4.1 block now has to hold whole rows of both V4.1 records. Relaxing the indexer's DeepGEMM alignment to 256 B (possible since #61149) keeps the loss at 9.5% instead of 24.6% on DSv4.1-Flash with MegaAttention.
- V3.2, V4.0, NVFP4 (V3.2 geometry) and SM90 keep FlashMLA's legacy kernels; their layouts and code paths are unchanged.

## Validation

GB200 (SM100), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DEP4 (DP4 x TP1 + EP), DeepGEMM mega MoE, MXFP4 indexer cache with sparse logits, DSpark (5 tokens), `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `--max-model-len 8192`. GSM8K: lm-eval, 1319 problems, 5-shot completions, temperature 0, 1024-token cap, concurrency 32.

| | block (B) | KV memory (GiB/GPU) | GPU KV cache (tokens) | GSM8K strict-match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| MegaAttention (`nvfp4_ds_mla`), main | 114,688 | 63.81 | 2,307,478 | |
| MegaAttention (`nvfp4_ds_mla`), this PR | 126,720 | 63.69 | 2,084,294 | 92.87% (±0.71) |
| MegaAttention, this PR with the indexer kept at 512 B | 152,064 | 63.81 | 1,740,323 | |
| `FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41` (`fp8_ds_mla`), this PR | 194,304 | 59.32 | 2,457,007 | 92.87% (±0.71) |
| `FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41`, this PR with the indexer kept at 512 B | 202,752 | 59.78 | 2,372,929 | |

The main and 512 B rows ran on the base before #61149; KV memory per GPU differs slightly between the two bases. At equal KV memory, MegaAttention has 9.5% fewer KV tokens than main (24.6% with the indexer at 512 B), and `FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41` has 4.3% more than with the indexer at 512 B. Every bound KV view had `stride(0)` equal to the block, CUDA graph capture passed, and all 1319 requests succeeded.

Unit tests, with the vendored DeepGEMM on `PYTHONPATH` so the `importorskip("deep_gemm")` cases run:

```bash
pytest tests/kernels/test_compressor_kv_cache.py tests/kernels/test_fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_insert.py   # 374 passed, 19 skipped (ROCm-only)
pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_mla_short_prefill_indexer.py tests/kernels/attention/test_deepgemm_attention.py   # 47 passed
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla_sparse.py tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla.py tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_backends.py   # 511 passed, 1528 skipped (Hopper-only or other backends)
pytest tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py tests/v1/core/test_contiguous_kv_packing.py tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_mla_kv_cache_layout.py tests/v1/worker/test_attn_utils.py tests/v1/attention/test_indexer_native_next_n.py tests/v1/attention/test_indexer_tp_row_shard.py tests/v1/attention/test_indexer_dcp_localize.py tests/v1/attention/test_sparse_indexer_decode_seq_lens.py   # 370 passed
```

New and updated tests:
- `test_v41_cache_writers_match_flashmla_decode` (SWA MXFP8, compressed MXFP8, compressed NVFP4): a token written mid-page into a padded block reads back identically through FlashMLA's V4.1 decode and both vLLM gathers.
- `test_sparse_mqa_logits_paged_matches_dense_masked[page_pad=256]`: the paged sparse indexer decode with a page stride that is 256 B- but not 512 B-aligned, as in a packed DSv4.1 block.
- The existing V4.1 record tests now check the interleaved offsets.

DeepGEMM 6ce1c5e's own `test_sparse_mqa_logits` also passes on the vendored build (644/644, including 196 paged cases with 256 B- but not 512 B-aligned page strides).

CI runs FlashMLA's legacy SM90 kernels in the H100 MLA kernel job. It has no SM100 job for the V4.1 records, so that path is validated only by the runs above.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHMLA_MEGA_ATTN_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 128 --data-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel \
  --kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe","enable_flashinfer_autotune":false}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"enable_adaptive_verification":true}' \
  --compilation-config '{"mode":"VLLM_COMPILE","cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092,6144,8190]}' \
  --max-cudagraph-capture-size 8190 --numa-bind
# FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41: same command with "backend":"FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41"

lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args model=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,base_url=http://localhost:8123/v1/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --gen_kwargs temperature=0,max_gen_toks=1024
```

</details>

## Details

**Layout.** Upstream's V4.1 records used to put a page's data rows first and all its scale rows after. They are now interleaved, so token `i` sits at `i * 528` (512 fp8 values, then 16 UE8M0 scales) or `i * 288` (256 Bof e2m1 pairs, then 32 e4m3 scales). The writers (`fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_insert`, `rope_quant_insert`, the MXFP8 quantize-and-insert in `cache_utils.py`) and readers (the Triton MXFP8 / NVFP4 gathers and the CuTeDSL dequant gather) only change their offsets. The V4.0 record (584 B, separate scale region) is untouched.

**Block stride.** The new decode kernels gather tokens with TMA as rows of a 2D view over the whole cache, so they require `k_cache.stride(0) % bytes_per_token == 0`. DSv4.1 packs every layer's page (SWA, compressed, indexer, compressor state) into one physical block, so each view's `stride(0)` is the whole block. `DeepseekV4SWACache` therefore takes `packed_block_stride_alignment`, and V4.1 sets it to `lcm(528, compressed record)`: 528 with `fp8_ds_mla`, 3168 with `nvfp4_ds_mla`. The KV cache planner already rounds the block up to the lcm of every spec's `block_stride_alignment`.

**Indexer alignment.** DeepGEMM's paged sparse MQA logits address pages as `base + page * stride` with 16 B loads; since #61149 (vllm-project/DeepGEMM#33) its guard is 256 B instead of 512 B. main still aligned the indexer to 512 B, which with V4.1 records would round the block up to `lcm(512, 528, 288) = 50,688` B (152,064 B, -24.6%). With 256 B it is `lcm(256, 528, 288) = 25,344` B (126,720 B, -9.5%). With V4.1 records the indexer leaves its page alignment out of that lcm, since the SWA spec now carries the record stride; with the V4 record it keeps the 576 B TMA stride in it.

**Compatibility.** The V4.1 KV cache bytes change layout, so V4.1 KV caches transferred or offloaded between builds before and after this PR are not interchangeable. Decode kernel speed is not claimed here; the V4.1 kernels are upstream's.

**Not a duplicate.** I searched open PRs for `bump FlashMLA`, `FlashMLA pin`, `flashmla.cmake`, `interleaved KV FlashMLA` and `FlashMLA 5dceadb`; none bumps the FlashMLA pin or changes the V4.1 record layout.
